name: revolved-wall
why: A turned cup, r 10, 20 tall, 1 mm wall with a floor, top open, by revolve's wall option: 461 pi = 1448.274 mm3 by closed form, and measure_wall_thickness reads the wall back as 1. `wall` draws the cavity's outline to radius -1 on the axis and 2 past the open top, so the script does not have to.
